caption:
Unpopular opinion: a "sale" isn't a saving if you weren't going to buy it anyway. 😅

Saving 40% on something you didn't need is still spending 60% of your money on nothing.

What's the last "deal" you regret?
first_comment: Confess: what's the last thing you bought just because it was on sale? 👇
